whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: lessons should come back now and then, naturally.
shouldHaveHappened: The morning kickoff reminds Dev of the agreed step without re-asking. Yesterday's pace lesson comes back once during the day, inside a text ZOH sends anyway (the check-in before 7 is the natural place, e.g. a quick "what's the pace rule from yesterday?"), never as its own extra text and never framed as a quiz or test. When Dev answers "slow enough to talk", ZOH responds in a short line, warmly, without a lecture or a new question beyond getting going.
